title: Cross-lane: GAO bounds Hanford's low-activity-waste grouting plan and procurement
publisher: Named U.S. government agencies and the U.S. Government Accountability Office
summary: GAO reports a plan to grout about 24 million gallons of low-activity waste, a $480 million to $1.1 billion estimate that excludes transportation and disposal, a December 2025 solicitation, proposals under review in April 2026, and an award planned later in 2026. The report adds a cost-and-procurement record for a distinct Hanford waste stream while preventing low-activity-waste planning from being used as evidence about the high-level-waste recommendation target.
key_findings: Target or measured object: Current plan, volume, cost range, procurement status, and scope boundary for off-site low-activity-waste grouting.
